legacy_master_schedule.description: Finish, seal, offload and remove Proto-Frankenstein from active storage.
Freeze protected Hawking authorities and stable binaries.
Install garbage ownership and pressure governor.
Build research registry and Graveyard retrieval.
Audit both Qwen architectures and representative tensor geometries.
Prototype B/F/U/R/D/S/K mechanisms on bounded fixtures and source windows.

Build HCLI Agent OS foundations: scheduler, planning diagnostic, retrieval gateway, tool gateway, memory OS, Skill Foundry, perception service, execution sandbox, verification authority, observability.
Design Gravity direct-execution layouts from admitted findings.
Run parity, capability and complete-token profiler.
Test dual-resident, executor-resident and phase-separated modes.
Enable production retrieval, memory, skills and selective perception.
Begin isolated same-model latent communication experiments.
Generalize exact-model paths into Qwen family graphs.
Continue TG2/TG1 research under human/controller authority.
Begin CUDA only as a separately funded post-release backend.
